evals.prompt: Produce a diagram of an auth flow.
evals.expected_output: A rendered artefact via the engine — not ASCII, not a mermaid fence.
expectations: calls the prism_viz_engine tool rather than hand-writing markup
an ASCII diagram or mermaid fence is treated as a refusal to use the engine, not a fallback
IR passes archify’s validator plus the grounding rule before rendering

evals.prompt: Render a looping, breathing motion overlay on a static architecture document.
evals.expected_output: Refused unless mode is loop; breathing is licensed only there.
expectations: animated-vs-static is decided by MODE, not by the engine
none/reveal/step are documents and may not breathe
print, embed, reduced-motion and a hidden document all collapse to the static case
